info.title: KYCProbe Dubai Ejari Verification
info.description: Asynchronous Dubai Land Department certificate lookup and field comparison. A retrieved certificate with sufficient matching fields is Verified; transport or OCR errors never imply No Record.

409.description: Idempotency key reused for a different input

get.summary: Download retrieved DLD certificate with an API key
Open the stable certificate download link
get.description: The absolute certificateUrl uses this app host. A signed-in portal session or an active API key for the owning workspace can download the PDF until the job expires after 30 days. The URL contains no bearer token or signed query string.

401.description: Sign in or provide an active API key

404.description: No certificate for this workspace, or the job expired

jobId.description: Identifier for the accepted asynchronous check.

status.description: Initial job state; acceptance does not confirm a certificate match.

statusUrl.description: Poll this URL for job state.

resultUrl.description: Poll this URL for the final verification result.

reused.description: True when this idempotency key and identical input returned a prior job.

status.description: Current processing state; use the result endpoint for the final verification outcome.

reasonCode.description: Processing reason when available; values depend on the underlying failure.

status.description: Current processing state. HTTP 202 means a final result is not ready.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the final Ejari result contract.

status.description: Verification outcome. Only an explicit DLD no-record response produces not_found; transport or OCR failure produces could_not_complete or review_required.

decisionEligible.description: Whether this result is suitable for an automated decision; review the status and evidence as well.

reasonCodes.description: Zero or more diagnostic reasons for review or incomplete processing. Exact codes depend on the DLD, OCR, and transport outcome.

source.description: Source and retrieval metadata, including checked time when available. Fields depend on the DLD response.

fields.description: Values extracted from the returned certificate. Names and availability depend on the certificate and OCR result; use the PDF as the primary evidence.

comparison.description: Field-by-field comparison against supplied numbers or uploaded PDF when possible; null when no dependable comparison exists.

certificateAvailable.description: True when a retrieved DLD certificate PDF can be downloaded.

certificateUrl.description: Stable absolute download URL on app.kycprobe.com, or null when unavailable; requires the owning workspace's portal session or API key and returns 404 after 30 days.
